mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 8.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that suppress consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months when UNRATE > 8.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of federal funds rate below 0.5% and CPIAUCSL below 225.0 indicates dovish monetary policy in low-inflation environment, stimulating risk-taking and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both conditions hold, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, housing starts above 500 thousand units and retail sales above 380 billion dollars signal robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both conditions hold, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained industrial production level above 95 indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 95, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in non-farm payrolls below 130,000 thousand persons signals labor market contraction that reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months when PAYEMS < 130000, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both conditions hold, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.
